title: Bridges Health: training and matchmaking for Horizon Europe consortia
organiser: ISERD, EIT Hub Israel and the EU Delegation to Israel
summary: A two-day in-person programme of masterclasses, moderated matchmaking and proposal drafting for Horizon Europe Health and Cancer Mission consortia.
details: It is aimed at experienced organisations from the EU and Horizon Europe Associated Countries. EIT Health is an ecosystem partner. Attendance is for selected participants, and the published application deadline was 16 September 2026.
why: Listed for reference because applications have closed. Organisations interested in health consortia can follow the organisers for later editions.
